I searched the code directly, because the devkb `change` pack returned no callers and said 4 call sites couldn't be attributed. The tests listed are matched by grep on how they call these methods. I didn't run them or trace them any further.

## Production methods that reach `ValidationContext.GetFromNonGenericContext`

**Direct callers** (each contains a call to it):
- `AbstractValidator.IValidator.Validate`, the explicit `IValidationContext` overload (`AbstractValidator.cs:85`).
- `AbstractValidator.IValidator.ValidateAsync`, the explicit `IValidationContext` overload (`AbstractValidator.cs:90`).
- `DefaultValidatorOptions.When`, the `Func<T, ValidationContext<T>, bool>` overloads on both `IRuleBuilderOptions` and `IRuleBuilderOptionsConditions` (`DefaultValidatorOptions.cs:202` and `:217`).
- `DefaultValidatorOptions.WhenAsync`, the `Func<T, ValidationContext<T>, CancellationToken, Task<bool>>` overloads on both interfaces (`DefaultValidatorOptions.cs:310` and `:325`).
- `RuleBase.IValidationRule.GetDisplayName`, the explicit `IValidationContext` overload (`RuleBase.cs:204`). It only calls it when the context is non-null.
- `ConditionBuilder.When` (`ConditionBuilder.cs:50`).
- `AsyncConditionBuilder.WhenAsync` (`ConditionBuilder.cs:116` and `:126`).

**Indirect callers**:
- Through `DefaultValidatorOptions.When` (context overload):
  - `DefaultValidatorOptions.When`, the `Func<T, bool>` overloads (`:175` and `:188`).
  - `DefaultValidatorOptions.Unless`, the `Func<T, ValidationContext<T>, bool>` overloads (`:257` and `:270`).
  - `DefaultValidatorOptions.Unless`, the `Func<T, bool>` overloads (`:229` and `:242`). I didn't read their bodies. I'm assuming they go through `When`.
- Through `DefaultValidatorOptions.WhenAsync` (context overload):
  - `DefaultValidatorOptions.WhenAsync`, the `(T, CancellationToken)` overloads (`:283` and `:296`).
  - `DefaultValidatorOptions.UnlessAsync`, the context overloads (`:365` and `:378`).
  - `DefaultValidatorOptions.UnlessAsync`, the `(T, CancellationToken)` overloads (`:337` and `:350`). I didn't read their bodies. I'm assuming they go through `WhenAsync`.
- Through `ConditionBuilder.When`:
  - `ConditionBuilder.Unless`.
  - `AbstractValidator.When` (both overloads).
  - `AbstractValidator.Unless` (both overloads).
- Through `AsyncConditionBuilder.WhenAsync`:
  - `AsyncConditionBuilder.UnlessAsync`.
  - `AbstractValidator.WhenAsync` (both overloads).
  - `AbstractValidator.UnlessAsync` (both overloads).
- `DefaultValidatorExtensions.ChildRules` (the collection `ChildRules` extension around `DefaultValidatorExtensions.cs:1178`). It calls `originalRule.GetDisplayName(...ParentContext)` inside a display-name lambda, so it reaches `RuleBase.IValidationRule.GetDisplayName`.
- `ValidatorDescriptor.GetName` calls `IValidationRule.GetDisplayName(null)`. It reaches the method statically, but the null guard means it never reaches `GetFromNonGenericContext` at runtime.

I found no other callers of `IValidator.Validate(IValidationContext)` or `ValidateAsync(IValidationContext, ...)` in `src`.

## Test files that exercise it
- `src/FluentValidation.Tests/AbstractValidatorTester.cs`: casts to `IValidator` and calls the non-generic `Validate` and `ValidateAsync`.
- `src/FluentValidation.Tests/ConditionTests.cs`
- `src/FluentValidation.Tests/SharedConditionTests.cs`
- `src/FluentValidation.Tests/CollectionValidatorWithParentTests.cs`
- `src/FluentValidation.Tests/CustomValidatorTester.cs`
- `src/FluentValidation.Tests/ForEachRuleTests.cs`
- `src/FluentValidation.Tests/RuleBuilderTests.cs`
- `src/FluentValidation.Tests/ValidatorTesterTester.cs`
- `src/FluentValidation.Tests/ValidatorDescriptorTester.cs`: only reaches `GetDisplayName(null)`, so it doesn't actually hit `GetFromNonGenericContext`.

The last six are matched on `When`, `Unless`, `WhenAsync` or `UnlessAsync` calls whose lambda takes a context argument. `RuleBuilderTests.cs` also calls `GetDisplayName(null)`, which doesn't reach it.
